translations.web: Don’t turn away to go after vain things which can’t profit or deliver, for they are vain.
translations.bsb: Do not turn aside after worthless things that cannot profit you or deliver you, for they are empty.
translations.kjv: And turn ye not aside: for then should ye go after vain things, which cannot profit nor deliver; for they are vain.
